definition.en: A machine that uses steam to move parts and do mechanical work.
definition.zh: 利用蒸汽带动零件运动、做机械功的机器。

definition.en: The chamber that holds steam while a piston moves inside it.
definition.zh: 容纳蒸汽、让活塞在里面运动的腔体。

definition.en: A close-fitting part that moves inside a cylinder when pressure pushes on its faces.
definition.zh: 贴近汽缸内壁、能在缸内运动的零件。压力会推它的两面。

definition.en: The difference in pressure between two sides of an object or space.
definition.zh: 物体或空间两侧压强的差别。

definition.en: The change from a gas, such as water vapour, into a liquid.
definition.zh: 水蒸气等气体变成液体的过程。

definition.en: A vessel outside the working cylinder where used steam cools and turns into water.
definition.zh: 独立于工作汽缸的容器，让排出的蒸汽冷却并凝结成水。

definition.en: A pump that removes air and mixed water from the condensing system.
definition.zh: 从冷凝系统中抽走空气和混合水的泵。

definition.en: Describes an engine whose piston does work while moving in either direction.
definition.zh: 指活塞朝两个方向运动时都能做功。

definition.en: Watt’s arrangement of linked bars that guides the piston rod along a nearly straight path.
definition.zh: 瓦特设计的连杆组合，引导活塞杆沿近似直线运动。

definition.en: A joint around which a bar or other part turns. The joint can stay fixed or move with the mechanism.
definition.zh: 杆或其他零件绕着转动的连接点。它可以固定，也可以随机构移动。

definition.en: A gear system in which a rod carries a planet gear around a sun gear fixed to the output shaft.
definition.zh: 传动杆带着行星轮，绕固定在输出轴上的太阳轮运动的齿轮机构。

definition.en: A wheel that stores energy as it spins and releases that energy to help keep motion steady.
definition.zh: 转动时储存能量，再释放能量、让运动较平稳的轮。

definition.en: A mechanism that responds to changes in speed and uses links to adjust the steam supply.
definition.zh: 随转速变化，通过连杆调节供汽量的机构。

definition.en: A valve that changes the size of the opening through which steam flows.
definition.zh: 改变蒸汽通道开口大小的阀。

definition.en: When a machine’s output changes the input that drives it, such as speed changing the steam supply.
definition.zh: 机器的输出反过来改变输入，例如转速变化带动供汽量改变。

definition.en: Energy transferred when a force moves an object. Only the force acting along the movement counts.
definition.zh: 力使物体移动时传递的能量。只计算沿移动方向作用的力。
